P.name: Mirror Image
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, when '''LeBlanc''' is damaged to {{sti|health|{{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}}}, she creates a {{tip|clone}} of herself, after which they both instantly become {{tip|invisibility|invisible}} for 1 second.
P.description2: The clone can cast basic attacks with no effect and lasts 8 seconds. Upon spawning, it starts moving up to 1900 units toward a random direction in front of '''LeBlanc's''' movement, determined at the moment of its spawning.

P.name: Mirror Image 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, when '''LeBlanc''' is damaged to {{sti|health|{{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}}}, she creates a {{tip|clone}} of herself, after which they both instantly become {{tip|invisibility|invisible}} for 1 second.

Q.name: Sigil of Malice
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' projects an orb at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and marks them for {{fd|3.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: '''LeBlanc's''' next damaging {{tip|champion ability|ability}} against the marked target will consume the mark to deal the {{ccs|same {{as|magic damage}}|magic}} again.
Q.description3: ''Sigil of Malice's'' orb deals {{as|{{pp|10 to 146|formula= 2 + 8 * level, capped at level 18}}<!--stops at 18--> '''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|minion|minions}} and refunds 100% of its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} and 30% of its remaining {{sti|cooldown}} if either the orb or its mark's consumption kills the target.

W.name: Distortion
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival and leaving a return pad at the cast location for 4 seconds. ''Distortion'' can be recast after {{fd|0.2}} seconds of the dash ending for the pad's duration.
W.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''LeBlanc''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} to ''Distortion's'' return pad, regardless of range.

E.name: Ethereal Chains
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' flings an illusory chain in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy it hits and forms a {{tip|tether}} between '''LeBlanc''' and the target for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
E.description2: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, it fractures to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target and {{tip|root}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
E.leveling2: {{st|Fracture Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 85% AP)}}|Total Damage|{{ap|50+80 to 130+240}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+85}}% AP)}}}}

R.name: Mimic
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''LeBlanc''' casts a mimicked version of her most recently used basic ability, applying the same effects and dealing {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Mimic: Sigil of Malice:}} The orb deals modified damage, while the mark consumption deals double that amount.
R.leveling2: {{st|Orb Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Mark Magic Damage|{{ap|70*2 to 230*2}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3 to 230*3}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
R.description4: {{sbc|Mimic: Ethereal Chains:}} The tether's application deals modified damage, while its fracturing deals double that amount.
